model: Epiphone Les Paul Standard '50s Electric Guitar - Goldtop
description: Solidbody Electric Guitar with Maple Top, Mahogany Body, Mahogany Neck, Rosewood Fingerboard, and 2 Humbucking Pickups - Goldtop
product_info: With the iconic look and sound of 1950s-era Les Pauls, the Epiphone Les Paul Standard '50s is full of vintage character and classic rock ’n’ roll vibe. A mahogany body pours out warm resonance, while a maple top punches up the tone with clarity and snap. The comfortable ’59 Rounded C neck snugs perfectly into your hand for easy chording and dynamic fret runs. Powered by Alnico ProBucker pickups, the Epiphone Les Paul Standard ’50s has a distinctive rock ’n’ roll growl when pushed and a warm, pleasant top end when you lay back. Premium appointments favored by Sweetwater's guitar elite, such as Epiphone Vintage Deluxe machine heads, LockTone ABR Tune-o-matic bridge, a Graph Tech nut, and high-quality CTS ’50s-style wiring, complete the package on this formidable tone machine.

model: Epiphone Joe Bonamassa '59 Les Paul Custom Electric Guitar - Antique Ebony
description: Solidbody Electric Guitar, Signature, with Mahogany Body, Mahogany Neck, Ebony Fingerboard, 2 Humbucking Pickups, and Bigsby B70 - Antique Ebony
product_info: As Bonamassa fans and vintage tone gurus alike here at Sweetwater, it's always a treat when the man himself shares instruments inspired by his extensive catalog of rare guitars. The Joe Bonamassa ’59 Les Paul Custom is based on what is perceived to be one of the rarest Les Pauls ever built — a late 1950s two-pickup “Black Beauty” with a Bigsby vibrato tailpiece. All the trimmings that make the original stand out are present in this carefully crafted all-mahogany-body Epiphone homage, from the aged binding and ‘50s-style rounded mahogany neck with ebony fingerboard down to the Grover Imperial tuning buttons. To complete the vintage vibe, the Joe Bonamassa ’59 Les Paul Custom comes stocked with a set of Epiphone ProBucker pickups bursting with PAF-inspired punch and dynamics. From museum-quality aesthetics to smooth playability, the Joe Bonamassa ’59 Les Paul Custom is built to serve as a stage-ready instrument worthy of the blues icon’s namesake.

model: Epiphone Inspired by Gibson Custom 1959 Les Paul Standard Reissue Electric Guitar
description: Solidbody Electric Guitar with Maple Top, Mahogany Body, Mahogany Neck, Rosewood Fingerboard, and 2 Humbucking Pickups - Washed Bourbon Sunburst
product_info: As Epiphone's Inspired by Gibson Custom range expands, so does your chance to score a seismic slice of 6-string history, with the revamped 1959 Les Paul Standard Reissue. Thanks to advances in laser-scanning replication technologies, Epiphone has produced the most historically accurate reproduction of the 1959 Les Paul Standard, at a fraction of the cost of a Gibson Custom equivalent. This Epiphone reissue includes a premium rosewood fretboard, a AAA flame maple top, and a galvanizing pair of USA Custombucker pickups, which Sweetwater's sound scholars agree masterfully capture the lauded PAF style of the original axe. With the exacting attention to detail dovetailing into the use of Luxe Bumblebee paper-in-oil capacitors, Epiphone's history-honoring Inspired by Gibson Custom 1959 Les Paul Standard Reissue elevates your sonic prowess to ferocious dimensions of time-tested tone and style.

model: Epiphone Adam Jones 1979 Les Paul Custom Electric Guitar - Antique Silverburst
description: Solidbody Electric Guitar, Signature, with Maple Top, Mahogany Body, Maple Neck, Ebony Fingerboard, and 2 Humbucking Pickups - Antique Silverburst
product_info: Longtime listeners and eagle-eyed admirers of Tool's Adam Jones have been waiting for an Epiphone iteration of his iconic axe, and that day has finally arrived. The Epiphone Adam Jones 1979 Les Paul Custom sports a feature set unique to late '70s Gibson instruments; the body is a classic maple-on-mahogany construction, but the neck's 3-piece maple design offers enhanced stability — it's even further upgraded with a sleek piece of ebony for the fingerboard! Under the hood, a bridge-position Seymour Duncan Distortion delivers the same searing high-gain tones found on many a Tool album, while the inverted Gibson Custombucker offers a smooth PAF-style shimmer for your cleaner moments. Lastly, the Epiphone Adam Jones 1979 Les Paul Custom sports all the elegance of a late '70s Les Paul Custom with multi-ply binding on just about every surface and a moody Silverburst finish.

model: Fender Player II Stratocaster Electric Guitar - Aged Cherry Burst with Maple Fingerboard
description: Solidbody Electric Guitar with Chambered Ash Body, Maple Neck and Fingerboard, and 3 Single-coil Pickups - Aged Cherry Burst
product_info: Blending historic Fender panache with the necessary tools for modern performance, the Fender Player II Stratocaster delivers a suite of versatile tone-crafting capabilities. A duo of premium tonewoods comprises chambered ash and maple, while Player series single-coil pickups span a spectrum of shimmering highs, tight lows, and sonorous midrange. Guitarists at Sweetwater are thrilled with Fender’s decision to introduce rolled edges to each axe’s fingerboards, augmenting both comfort and accessibility. What’s more, Fender dove deep into the archives to resurrect iconic finishes — some of which have never been seen in the series! Between eye-catching aesthetics and a 2-point synchronized tremolo, the Fender Player II Stratocaster is your key to unparalleled expression and next-level playability.

model: Fender Player II Modified Telecaster Electric Guitar - Olympic Pearl with Maple Fingerboard
description: Solidbody Electric Guitar with Alder Body, Maple Neck, Maple Fingerboard, and 2 Single-coil Pickups - Olympic Pearl
product_info: The Fender Player II Modified Telecaster couples a hot-rodded combination of classic design and player-centric features that bridges the gap between iconic Tele tone and modern performance. With its Player II Noiseless pickups and a modified circuit featuring a treble bleed, the Player II Modified Telecaster operates with a noise-free, consistent tone — even at lower volumes. You can even inject humbucker thickness with a push-pull series switch pot that runs the single-coils in series. An alder body, a modern C maple neck, and a rolled fingerboard add up to refined playability, complete with newly designed sting trees and short shaft locking tuners for added stability. Sweetwater Tele fans who long for the brass of vintage instruments delight in this guitar’s secret: six satin chrome-plated brass saddles that facilitate trademark sustain while offering advanced intonation adjustment. Overall, the features and playability of the Player II Modified Tele culminate in an instrument with the classic aesthetic and feel you crave, as well as modern advancements that will elevate your playing experience.

model: Fender American Ultra II Stratocaster HSS Electric Guitar
description: Solidbody Electric Guitar with Alder Body, Maple Neck, Ebony Fingerboard, Synchronized Tremolo, 2 Single-coil Pickups, and 1 Humbucking Pickup - Ultraburst
product_info: Emboldened with a hard-hitting Haymaker humbucker, the Fender American Ultra II Stratocaster HSS reshapes and refines Leo Fender’s iconic double-cut guitar for the performance-minded musician. From the second you sling up this Strat, you’ll enjoy enhanced playing comfort thanks to the select alder body’s tapered neck heel and deep neck joint contour. Naturally, these changes grant effortless access to the Modern D quartersawn maple neck’s compound-radius fingerboard, which boasts Ultra Rolled edges for a seamless feel against your palm. The electronics section begins with two Ultra II Noiseless Hot Strat pickups in the neck and middle positions, providing a searing single-coil bite to balance against the heat of the bridge position’s Haymaker humbucker. Plus, Fender’s S-1 switch splits the Haymaker into a shimmering single-coil to give you access to traditional SSS Strat sonics. You also get a host of high-performance hardware appointments, including Fender’s 2-point American Ultra Synchronized tremolo, a cold-rolled steel trem block, Deluxe locking tuners, and a stylish 1-ply aluminum pickguard. Cutting-edge and classic all at once, the American Ultra II Stratocaster HSS elevates Fender’s time-tested S-style formula to bold new HSS heights.

description: Solidbody Electric Guitar with Poplar Body, Maple Neck, Maple Fingerboard, 3 Single-coil Pickups, and Tremolo - Candy Cola
product_info: When you’re ready to experience quintessential Fender design and playability, look no further than the Fender Standard Stratocaster. Built with the player in mind, the standard design allows beginners and aficionados alike to experience essential Fender features that make the brand’s guitars the first choice of so many Sweetwater guitarists. With a satin-finished and time-tested modern C-shaped neck and a 9.5-inch-radius maple fingerboard, this guitar is immensely comfortable for both chords and individually fretted notes. The Standard Single-coil Strat pickups offer the iconic snappy tone, with high-output ceramic magnets that offer a more aggressive sound at full volume. Achieve patented Strat vibrato and dynamic versatility with the onboard 2-point synchronized tremolo system, complete with even tension that is easy to use and stays in tune. Whether you’re buying your first guitar or looking to add some Strat sparkle to your collection, the Standard Stratocaster offers all the playability, tonality, and style a Fender guitar can provide.

model: Gibson Les Paul Studio Session Electric Guitar - Bourbon Burst
description: Solidbody Electric Guitar with Mahogany Body, Maple Top, Mahogany Neck, Ebony Fingerboard, and 2 Humbucking Pickups - Bourbon Burst
product_info: The Gibson Les Paul Studio Session builds on the legacy of its no-frills predecessor with a well-thought-out selection of cosmetic, performance, and electronic updates. To start, the Les Paul Studio Session’s weight-relieved mahogany body is crowned with an eye-grabbing flame maple top. This solidbody electric guitar’s mahogany neck brandishes Gibson’s crowd-pleasing SlimTaper neck profile, which is bolstered by a modern contoured heel for easier playability and an upgraded bound ebony fingerboard. A set of ’57 Classic pickups provides you with supercharged PAF-flavored tones, which are reinforced by four push-pull knobs for easy access to coil tap, out-of-phase, and pure bypass options. You also get Grover Rotomatic tuners with Keystone buttons, head-turning acrylic trapezoid fingerboard inlays, a “Les Paul Model” headstock overlay, and a Gibson logo headstock inlay for authentic Les Paul aesthetics. The Gibson Les Paul Studio Session offers discerning players an appointment-laden real-deal Gibson at an accessible price that’s impossible to pass up.

model: Gibson Les Paul Standard '60s Figured Top Electric Guitar - Blueberry Burst
description: Solidbody Electric Guitar with Mahogany Body, Maple Top, Mahogany Neck, Rosewood Fingerboard, and 2 Humbucking Pickups - Blueberry Burst
product_info: The Gibson Les Paul Standard '60s Figured Top boasts the classic design that's kept this solidbody electric guitar relevant, played, and loved throughout the decades. You won't be able to take your eyes off this Les Paul Standard's figured maple top, and its '60s Burstbucker pickups milk every ounce of tone out of its musically resonant mahogany body. The Les Paul Standard '60s Figured Top's set mahogany neck wields Gibson's time-tested SlimTaper profile, and its Plek'd 12-inch-radius Indian rosewood fingerboard offers playability that's second to none. A Graph Tech nut, ABR-1 Tune-o-matic bridge, aluminum stopbar tailpiece, and Grover Rotomatic tuners with kidney buttons round out this Les Paul Standard's hardware. You also get single-ply body and fingerboard binding, acrylic trapezoid fingerboard inlays, a mother-of-pearl headstock logo, and a spotlight-stealing nitrocellulose lacquer finish. If you've been wanting a modern Les Paul with a slinky '60s feel and premium appointments, Sweetwater has your axe. The Gibson Les Paul Standard '60s Figured Top is the one you've been waiting for.

model: Ibanez Prestige RG5320C Electric Guitar - Deep Forest Green Metallic
description: Solidbody Electric Guitar with Mahogany Body, 5-piece Maple/Wenge Neck, Macassar Ebony Fretboard, 2 Humbucking Pickups, and Tremolo - Deep Forest Green Metallic
product_info: When you combine Ibanez's decades of guitar building expertise with player-centric upgrades and modifications, the result is the Ibanez Prestige RG5320C. Made with a lightweight mahogany body and 5-piece maple/wenge neck, this guitar flaunts a resonant tone that won't weigh you down over long gigs or sessions. It's loaded with a powerful pair of DiMarzio humbucking pickups — an Air Norton at the neck position and a Tone Zone at the bridge — with built-in coil tap capabilities to cover maximum tonal territory. And to make the ultra-thin Super Wizard HP neck even more playable, Ibanez rounded the fret edges with their Prestige fret edge treatment for an amazingly smooth feel. With its incredible playability and powerful tone, it's clear that the Ibanez Prestige RG5320C is made for the discerning player who needs to rock at high speed.

description: Solidbody Electric Guitar with Poplar Body, Maple Neck, Amaranth Fingerboard, and 2 Humbucking Pickups - Viola Burst
product_info: Part of Jackson's JS Series, the JS32T Kelly solidbody electric guitar packs a lot of value. A pair of high-output ceramic-magnet humbuckers hits your amplifier with huge tone — just what you need for aggressive performance. And while the price is low, you'll be astounded at how good the JS32T Kelly plays. The compound-radius fretboard makes it easy to blaze around the neck, and the graphite-reinforced maple neck is designed for a long life of reliable action. Whether you're just starting to rock or are looking for a value-packed shred machine, you'll be impressed with the Jackson JS32T Kelly.

model: Yamaha PAC012DLX Pacifica Electric Guitar - Old Violin Sunburst
description: 6-string Solidbody Electric with Mahogany Body, Maple Neck, Rosewood Fingerboard, and 2 Single-coil and 1 Humbucking Pickup - Old Violin Sunburst
product_info: The Yamaha PAC012 Pacifica comes with a custom Yamaha ceramic humbucker in the bridge position, perfect for when you want to rock hard and heavy. Two single-coil pickups in the middle and neck positions offer up all kinds of clean, rocking single-coil tones as well. The range this trio of versatile pickups offers lets you explore all kinds of stylistic approaches in just about any genre — and at Sweetwater, we're all about exploration!
